finding: src/anomaly/workflow.py:119 The multi-phase loop does not recheck whole-case containment after dynamic reasoning owners mutate the case.
rationale: The finding is reachable: run_workflow performs its only whole-tree scan before the loop, grants the external reasoning invoker the case root, and after that invoker returns run_attempts writes through the previously created attempt directory with no rescan or symlink-parent guard, so an owner that replaces that directory with a symlink can make the same public call write result.json outside the case.

evidence.output: 111: _scan_case_tree(case_root); 119: while True; 128-138: run_attempts(... lambda attempt_dir: consume_owner(...)); there is no _scan_case_tree call in the loop before or after owner execution.

workflow.py:99 passes case_root=Path(case_root) to the external invoke callable; owners.py:49-55 calls that reasoning owner for P5 and accepts its return after only checking that findings/draft.json is_file().

attempts.py creates attempt_dir before invocation, then executes the owner and calls _write_output(attempt_dir, output); _write_output calls write_json_atomic(attempt_dir / "result.json", payload). state.py implements that helper as temporary.write_text(...) followed by temporary.replace(path), with no containment rescan or symlink-parent rejection.
